N-add07#2.zh: 废话少说，想活着离开的话，把身上财物留下来！
N-add07#2.t: Cut the chatter. If you want to leave alive, hand over your valuables!

N-add07#3.zh: 什...什么？！你们没搞错吧，我们可是强盗啊！你们竟然向强盗打劫？！
N-add07#3.t: Wh... what?! Are you serious? We're bandits! You're robbing bandits?!

N-add07#4.zh: 哈哈！咱们从前都是干强盗头子的，这回你们可踢到铁板了吧！
N-add07#4.t: Haha! We used to be bandit chiefs ourselves. You've kicked a steel plate this time!

N-add07#5.zh: 这伙剪径贼胆子不大：喽啰挨了重手就会丢下财物求饶，打倒他们的头领，其余的自然散伙。
N-add07#5.t: These highwaymen aren't brave: badly hurt, the lackeys drop their loot and beg for mercy. Beat their chief and the rest will scatter.

N-add07#7.zh: 胜利条件   --- 打败头领（喽啰体力不到一半便会求饶）
N-add07#7.t: Victory --- Defeat the chief (lackeys beg for mercy below half HP)

N-add07#9.zh: 限制回合数已到，未完成任务，游戏失败！

N-add07#10.zh: %N死亡，众人不敌盗贼围攻，荒野平添几缕英魂........
N-add07#10.t: %N died. Overwhelmed by the bandits, the group left only a few more heroic ghosts in the wilds........

N-add07#12.zh: 头领一倒，剩下的喽啰都丢了刀枪，把劫来的财物一包包献了出来。
N-add07#12.t: With their chief down, the remaining lackeys threw away their weapons and handed over their loot, bundle by bundle.

N-add07#13.zh: 众好汉反把剪径贼劫了个干净。
N-add07#13.t: Our heroes robbed the highwaymen clean.

N-add07#14.zh: 好汉饶命！银子都给你们！
N-add07#14.t: Mercy, good sir! Take all the silver!

N-add07#15.t: Stop! The bundles are all here!

N-add07#17.zh: 财物都留下，放小的一条生路！
N-add07#17.t: Take the loot, just let me live!
